versions.changelog:
- Added detailed SKILL.md with instructions for installing and using inference.sh CLI to generate images with FLUX models.
- Included model descriptions, use cases, and example commands for text-to-image, image-to-image, and LoRA-based style adaptation.
- Listed related skills and external documentation links for further guidance.

Initial release of flux-image skill.

- Generate images using FLUX Dev LoRA and FLUX.2 Klein LoRA models via inference.sh CLI.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, LoRA fine-tuning, and custom style adaptation.
- Provides usage examples and model comparison for quality and speed.
- Includes instructions for image editing and upscaling with related models.
- Offers triggers for easy invocation and links to documentation for further help.
